We need answer only JSON per schema. Need extract claims from review. Need inspect source_text: "'\nThese are fairly easy to put on but there were something on the actual sticky part that I couldn’t get off so I had to throw one away but they work really good"

Product maybe screen protector? B07H2V5YLH unknown. We have taxonomy. Need claims with exact evidence spans continuous substring. Need zero or multiple. Determine claims.

Text: "These are fairly easy to put on" -> usability_installation ease_of_use positive? "fairly easy to put on" yes claim positive. Evidence span exact: "These are fairly easy to put on" maybe includes capital T. It says source_text has ‘\nThese... We can copy "These are fairly easy to put on". primary usability_installation secondary ease_of_use polarity positive.

"but there were something on the actual sticky part that I couldn’t get off so I had to throw one away" -> product_quality? defective_on_arrival? There was something on sticky part couldn't get off, had to throw one away. This is defective on arrival perhaps accessory_condition? It's about sticky part contamination/debris, had to throw one away. Primary product_quality, secondary defective_on_arrival? Negative. Evidence: "there were something on the actual sticky part that I couldn’t get off so I had to throw one away" exact continuous substring. Contains grammar. That seems product defect. Could be usability_installation bubbles_adhesion? Sticky part not being clean? But defective_on_arrival more apt: item had something on sticky part. Need choose exactly one valid pair. Maybe primary product_quality, secondary defective_on_arrival. Polarity negative.

"but they work really good" -> function_performance general_performance positive. Evidence: "they work really good" exact. Primary function_performance, secondary general_performance, positive.

Need ensure no sentiment from star rating. Claims include perhaps "fairly easy to put on" positive; "work really good" positive; defect negative. Does "throw one away" indicates defective. Evidence span maybe "there were something on the actual sticky part that I couldn’t get off" enough? Need include "had to throw one away" maybe negative. But exact continuous substring includes all. Good.

Potential issue: "These are fairly easy to put on but there were something..." Could combine? We separate.

Need output JSON with claims array. Ensure valid enum strings. evidence_span exact substring from source_text. Need copy apostrophes: source has "couldn’t" with curly apostrophe U+2019, "throw" etc. The source_text: "‘\nThese are fairly easy to put on but there were something on the actual sticky part that I couldn’t get off so I had to throw one away but they work really good". We can include "These are fairly easy to put on"; "there were something on the actual sticky part that I couldn’t get off so I had to throw one away"; "they work really good". All are exact substrings. Need JSON.

Also "there were something" grammatical but exact. Do not correct.

Question says "For every claim choose exactly one valid primary/secondary taxonomy pair, independently determine polarity, and copy evidence_span as an exact continuous substring from SOURCE_TEXT. Do not infer sentiment from star rating. Do not invent evidence or topics. If no supported product claim exists, return empty list."

Need maybe include title? no claims only. Use double quotes.

Check if "These are fairly easy to put on" is product claim? yes ease of installation. primary usability_installation secondary ease_of_use. Polarity positive.

Defect: "there were something on the actual sticky part that I couldn’t get off so I had to throw one away" Could be product_quality defective_on_arrival. It indicates one item had something on sticky part. But if product is not necessarily on arrival? The reviewer says "there were something on actual sticky part" maybe manufacturing defect. defective_on_arrival fits. Negative. Evidence exact. Could also be accessory_condition? No, sticky part of product. product_quality.

"they work really good" function_performance general_performance positive.

Need final no markdown. Ensure JSON schema. Let's produce.
